notes_for_editor: Administration conflict: the register says Cal Fire administers the site; the Forest Service project page says the site is administered by Plumas National Forest and sits in the proclaimed Lassen National Forest. The record's agency is Cal Fire and its ownership is 'federal'; neither was changed. Build date and timeline: the 1937 obituary has Dave Reese at the peak for six years and in Forest Service employ nine years before 1937, which would predate the register's 1931 date. Either an earlier structure stood there or a date is off; unresolved. Cab history: the original wood cab was destroyed by fire, but no year is given, and the replacement cab is undated. Current status: the register has no status field. Its description, marked MVT 10/91, refers to the existing cab, and the Forest Service project summary uses the present tense for the lookout. Nothing dated after 2019 confirms the lookout is standing today, so status 'standing' rests on those two sources. The Butte County Battalion 1 page returned HTTP 403 to both our fetch and WebFetch, so current staffing and camera coverage are unconfirmed. A search summary said staffing has ended and two ALERTCalifornia cameras cover the site; not verified, not used. Register number: a California lookout directory row seemed to show NHLR US 1358, CA 181; the register page says US 1310, CA 133, and the register's own number is used. A 1967 item about a seismograph theft names 'Saw Mill Peak Lookout Station in Shasta County'; it is a different county and is not used. Access: no source read says whether the public may visit. No new photos added.
